d:
In this video, we walk you through Trade From Charts (TFC) on the Kite app and show how you can manage your trades directly from TradingView charts. You can place and modify orders, manage open positions, view market depth, use instant order placement, and switch between instruments without moving away from the chart.
We also cover multiple chart layouts, comparing instruments, reversing positions, and a few settings that can help customise your charting and trading experience.
